//: Biomes: what tiles are made of. Style, region and quality decide what a building is; terrain decides the land.

lodging_front: A timbered inn with a painted sign creaking on its bracket. Smoke curls from the chimney and the door stands open on a warm, loud room.
lobby_desc: Long trestle tables, benches worn smooth, and a fire big enough to roast an ox.
A low, smoky room of settles and tables, a barrel tapped behind the counter.
floor_line: Fresh rushes are strewn over the flagstones.
The floorboards are scrubbed pale and creak at every step.
dining_desc: A smaller room off the common room, with a table under the window.
food_line: The smell of #local_food# drifts from the kitchen.
kitchen_desc: A hot kitchen of copper pots, a spit over the fire and a cook who doesn't want you here.
stair_desc: A narrow wooden stair climbs to the guest rooms, each step complaining.
corridor_desc: A low-beamed landing with doors on either side.
light_line: A single candle burns in a niche.
guest_room_desc: A small room under the eaves with a washstand and a chest.
bed_line: The bed is stuffed with straw and fairly free of fleas.
window_line: A shuttered window looks out over #view#.
square_desc: A cobbled market square around a stone cross. Stalls sell #local_food# and cheap knives.
street_desc: A crooked street of overhanging timber houses, the gutter running down its middle.
shop_desc: A shop open to the street, its wares hanging from the beams.
temple_desc: Cool stone, candles, and a smell of old incense.
house_desc: A narrow room with a bed, a table, a chest and a crucifix.
dungeon_desc: A vaulted cell of dripping stone, rusted chains bolted to the wall.
A passage of rough-cut stone, torch brackets empty.
vault_desc: A strongroom behind an iron-bound door, where something was kept that someone wanted kept.
building_view: the thatched roofs of the town

lodging_name: The Inn at the World's End
lodging_front: A crooked little inn with a roof like a pointed hat and windows that seem to wink.
lobby_desc: A parlour where the chairs are slightly too small and the clock runs backwards.
floor_line: The floor is a patchwork of painted tiles, each one a different flower.
food_line: A pie on the sill smells of #local_food# and honey.
light_line: Fireflies drift about in a glass jar, giving a soft green light.
bed_line: The bed is piled with twenty mattresses. There may be a pea.
dungeon_desc: A twisting burrow lined with roots and stolen teaspoons.
dining_desc: A round table set for exactly as many guests as there are, however many that is.
kitchen_desc: A kitchen where the spoons stir by themselves and a kettle sings real songs.
stair_desc: A spiral stair that seems to have more steps going up than coming down.
corridor_desc: A crooked passage of little round doors, each painted a different colour.
guest_room_desc: A tiny room with a round window and a patchwork quilt.
window_line: The round window looks out on #view#, which may be painted on.
square_desc: A crooked square around a wishing well, the houses leaning in to listen.
street_desc: A street of gingerbread houses with candy-cane railings, slightly sticky underfoot.
shop_desc: A shop crammed to the rafters with curious things, some of which are watching you.
temple_desc: A chapel lit by a single star that hangs in the rafters.
house_desc: A cosy room of rag rugs and a fire with a cat who seems to be in charge.

lodging_front: A #lodging_storeys#-storey hotel with a lit sign, a glass door and a row of parked cars.
lobby_desc: A reception desk with a bell and a bored clerk, a rack of tourist leaflets, a coffee machine.
floor_line: The carpet is patterned to hide stains.
The floor is polished tile that squeaks underfoot.
dining_desc: Small tables, a buffet counter, a television on the wall showing the news.
food_line: There's a smell of coffee and #local_food#.
kitchen_desc: Steel counters, extractor fans, a walk-in fridge humming.
stair_desc: A stairwell with fire doors, and an elevator with an OUT OF ORDER sign.
corridor_desc: A long corridor of numbered doors and an ice machine.
guest_room_desc: A hotel room: a desk, a television, a print of a sailing boat.
bed_line: The bed is made with hospital corners.
window_line: Blackout curtains hide a view of the car park.
square_desc: A main street of shops with plate-glass windows, traffic lights and parked cars.
street_desc: A street of low buildings, telephone poles and a diner with a neon sign.
shop_desc: A shop with a buzzing sign, a counter, and shelves of everything.
temple_desc: Plastic chairs in rows and a noticeboard of bake sales.
house_desc: A living room of a sofa, a television and family photographs.
dungeon_desc: A concrete corridor stained with rust, a caged bulb overhead.
A utility tunnel of pipes and cable trays.
vault_desc: A sealed room behind a blast door, its shelves still stocked.

lodging_front: A nine-storey concrete slab of identical balconies, laundry strung across half of them. The entrance is a steel door with a broken intercom.
lobby_desc: Rows of dented metal mailboxes, a noticeboard of stern announcements, and the concierge's window.
floor_line: The linoleum is cracked and patched with more linoleum.
dining_desc: Formica tables, a serving hatch, a portrait of somebody important.
food_line: The canteen smells of #local_food# and boiled cabbage.
kitchen_desc: Huge aluminium pots on a gas range that has seen a lot.
stair_desc: A concrete stairwell that echoes. The lift is broken, as it has been for years.
corridor_desc: A landing of padded doors, each with a peephole.
light_line: A single bare bulb lights the whole landing.
The light is on a timer that runs out halfway up.
guest_room_desc: A flat of one room and a kitchenette, a carpet hung on the wall for warmth.
bed_line: A fold-out sofa serves as the bed.
window_line: The window looks out on the identical block opposite.
square_desc: A vast windy square around a concrete monument, flower beds in regimented rows.
street_desc: A broad avenue of apartment blocks and a trolleybus line.
shop_desc: A state shop with a queue and not much on the shelves.
temple_desc: A hall with a stage, red curtains and folding seats.
house_desc: A neat flat: a glass cabinet of china, a samovar, a rug on the wall.
dungeon_desc: A shelter corridor of gas masks in crates and faded posters on what to do if.

lodging_front: An airlock-style entrance under a holographic sign that cycles through six languages.
lobby_desc: A curved concourse of white panels, a check-in terminal and a robot porter powered down in its alcove.
floor_line: The floor is a grip-mesh of brushed steel.
Light strips run along the floor.
dining_desc: A galley of dispensers and bolted-down tables.
food_line: The dispensers smell faintly of #local_food# and ozone.
kitchen_desc: Food synthesisers in a row, one blinking an error.
stair_desc: A lift tube hums, ready to carry you up.
corridor_desc: A curving passage of numbered hatches.
light_line: Soft blue light comes from nowhere in particular.
guest_room_desc: A sleeping cabin: a bunk, a wall screen and a porthole.
bed_line: The bunk adjusts to your weight with a sigh.
square_desc: A domed plaza of hydroponic planters under an artificial sky.
street_desc: A slidewalk passage between modular habitats.
shop_desc: A counter, a scanner and racks of sealed goods.
dungeon_desc: A dark deck of sealed bulkheads and failing emergency lights.

lodging_front: An imposing frontage of polished stone and brass, a doorman under the awning.
decor_line: Gilded mirrors double the room, and fresh flowers stand in every corner.
Everything that could be marble is marble.
bed_line: The bed is vast and soft, the linen crisp as paper.
staff_line: A uniformed attendant bows as you pass.

lobby.name: chandelier
lobby.description: A cascade of crystal drops. It would cost a lifetime's wages.

decor_line: Everything is mended, nothing matches, and all of it is clean.
The furniture has seen several owners.
bed_line: The mattress sags in the middle.
staff_line: The owner does everything here, and looks tired.

!lodging_front: A boarded-up building, its sign hanging by one bolt and its windows smashed. The door has been kicked in.
What is left of a place that once took guests: sagging roof, empty windows, a weed-choked yard.
!lobby_desc: A gutted entrance hall. The counter is overturned and papers drift in the corners.
!food_line: Nothing has been cooked here in years.
!light_line: No lights work; daylight comes in through the holes.
!kitchen_desc: A kitchen stripped of everything worth taking, its pots rusting where they fell.
decor_line: Everything is thick with dust, and something has been nesting in the curtains.
Half the ceiling is down, and weeds push up through the floor.
bed_line: The bed has collapsed into a heap of mildew.
staff_line: Nobody has worked here for years.

decor_line: A framed print of a hunting scene hangs crooked above the fireplace.
view: grey slate roofs in the drizzle

decor_line: Painted Talavera tiles frame the doorway.
A string of papel picado flutters overhead.
view: a dusty plaza and a white church
agave fields under a hard sun

decor_line: A stuffed salmon is mounted over the counter.
Flannel cushions, and a framed map of the logging roads.
Red paper lanterns hang in rows.
A scroll of calligraphy hangs on the wall.

lodging_front: Low white buildings among leaning palms, a sandy path leading down to the sea.
decor_line: Rattan furniture, slowly turning ceiling fans, and an orchid in every alcove.
Sea air blows through the open louvres.
A Navajo rug hangs on the wall beside a faded Route 66 map.
Cow skulls and dried chiles decorate the doorframe.
view: red mesas under a vast sky
a dust devil spinning across the scrub

terrain_view: Red mesas stand on the horizon like ships, and the scrub shimmers in the heat.
The land is red rock and sagebrush under an enormous sky.

details: A lizard watches you from a hot rock.
The heat comes up off the ground in waves.

terrain_view: Dunes roll away in every direction, rippled by the wind.
Flat stony desert, empty to the horizon.

details: The wind hisses sand against your legs.

terrain_view: Jungle presses in, green and dripping and loud with insects.
Vines hang from trees so tall you can't see their tops.

details: Something large moves in the canopy.
The air is like a wet cloth.

terrain_view: Frozen plains under a white sky, wind-scoured and silent.
Lichen and snow, and the low sun casting long blue shadows.

details: Your breath freezes on your collar.

terrain_view: Surf rolls up a long beach, and gulls wheel overhead.
Dunes give way to a wide strand and a grey-green sea.

details: The tide hisses on the shingle.
